integrity: All mathematical identities follow from a finite-dimensional reversible Poisson equation and an explicit singular-resolvent argument. Independent rational full-generator calculations are corroborative only. No claim of exhaustive literature originality or independent scientific validation.
limitations: Finite weighted undirected graphs, autonomous on/off edges with one global two-state gate, fixed canonical particle number and linear integrated occupation observables. Stationary long-time variance precedes slow-switching limit; no thermodynamic, nonstationary or higher-cumulant result.
title: A sharp graph-cut law for stationary occupation noise in gated symmetric exclusion
